```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Loading Data
```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_methylation_data.csv')
BRCA_methylation_data_original <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_sample_sheet.csv')
BRCA_sample_sheet <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```


## Data Preparation

I. Extraction of the "Type" column of the sample sheet
```{r}
BRCA_type_extracted <- BRCA_sample_sheet$Type
BRCA_type_extracted
```

II. Conversion into vector
```{r}
BRCA_type_extracted_vector <- c(BRCA_type_extracted)
is.vector(BRCA_type_extracted_vector)
```

III. Merge 
```{r}
BRCA_type_combined <- rbind(BRCA_methylation_data_original, BRCA_type_extracted_vector )
```

I. Extraction of the "Vital Status" column of the sample sheet
```{r}
BRCA_vital_extracted <- BRCA_sample_sheet$Vital.status
BRCA_vital_extracted
```

II. Conversion into Vector 
```{r}
BRCA_vital_extracted_vector <- c(BRCA_vital_extracted)
is.vector(BRCA_vital_extracted_vector)
```

III. Merge
```{r}
BRCA_methylation_type_vital <- rbind(BRCA_type_combined, BRCA_vital_extracted_vector ) 
```

# Partitioning patients into groups based on respective clinical parameters (Tumor Type) from the annotation dataframe

```{r}
type_primary <- which(BRCA_methylation_type_vital[426462, ] == "Primary solid Tumor")
data_type_primary <- BRCA_methylation_type_vital[type_primary]
dim(data_type_primary)
```

```{r}
type_solid <- which(BRCA_methylation_type_vital[426462, ] == "Solid Tissue Normal")
data_type_solid <- BRCA_methylation_type_vital[type_solid]
dim(data_type_solid)
```

Removing additional rows from methylation Dataframe
```{r}
patient_primary_type <- head(data_type_primary, -2) # zusätzliche Zeilen wieder entfernen 
patient_solid_type <- head(data_type_solid, -2)
dim(patient_primary_type)
dim(patient_solid_type)
```

Converting non-numeric values to numeric values
```{r}
print(class(patient_primary_type))
patient_primary_type <- as.data.frame(sapply(patient_primary_type, as.numeric))
str(patient_primary_type)
print(class(patient_solid_type))
patient_solid_type <- as.data.frame(sapply(patient_solid_type, as.numeric))
str(patient_solid_type)
```

Creating Density Plots

```{r}
# create each column of dataframe into a vector using unlist function
beta_werte_primary <- unlist(patient_primary_type)

# create density function
dichte_primary <- density(beta_werte_primary)

# Plot density function
plot(dichte_primary, main = "Density plot for primary solid Tumor ", xlab = "ß-Values", ylab = "Density", col='red')

```

```{r}
# create each column of dataframe into a vector using unlist function
beta_werte_solid <- unlist(patient_solid_type)

# create density function
dichte_solid <- density(beta_werte_solid)

# Plot density function
plot(dichte_solid, main = "Density plot for Solid Tissue Normal ", xlab = "ß-Values", ylab = "Density", col='blue')
```

Combining the two plots:
```{r}
library(ggplot2)


dichte_primary <- density(beta_werte_primary)
dichte_solid <- density(beta_werte_solid)

# Erstellen des ggplot-Objekts
plot_type <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(x = dichte_primary$x, y = dichte_primary$y), aes(x = x, y = y, color = "Primary solid Tumor"), size = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(x = dichte_solid$x, y = dichte_solid$y), aes(x = x, y = y, color = "Solid Tissue Normal"), size = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Density plot for tumor type", x = "ß-Values", y = "Density") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Primary solid Tumor" = "red", "Solid Tissue Normal" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Zeige den Plot an
print(plot_type)

# Speichere den Plot als PDF
ggsave("Density_plots_Exploration.pdf", plot = plot_type, width = 10, height = 8)

```
